tools.name: get_tool_help
tools.description: Describe one tool visible on this facade, including its input contract, access limits, refusals, example, outputs, and recommended next calls.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: List the current catalog-published data packs and their access lanes. Start here, then call get_pack for one selected pack.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Describe one catalog-published pack, including sources, metrics, coverage, freshness, access, and a first query. Call this before querying an unfamiliar pack.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Query one catalog-published source or pack with structured metrics, filters, sorting, and a row limit. Call get_catalog and get_pack before an unfamiliar dataset.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Free discovery. Returns the list of live agent-ready data packs available on DaedalMap." → after: "List the current catalog-published data packs and their access lanes. Start here, then call get_pack for one selected pack."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
